Advanced Manufacturing and Processing Excellence

Quality begins at the farm level. First, our expert procurement team selects mature, nutrient-dense Bahera fruits. Next, we clean, dry, and pulverize the dried fruits under strict temperature controls. As a result, our pure bahera fruit powder retains its natural bioactive compounds, distinct flavor profile, and fine mesh consistency. Modern technology drives our production lines. We utilize automated grinding and sieving machinery to ensure uniform particle size. Furthermore, continuous microbial testing safeguards every batch against contamination. Above all, our systematic approach guarantees that you receive consistent, premium-grade ingredients every single time.

  • 100% natural Terminalia Bellirica with no added fillers or synthetic additives.

  • Strict moisture-controlled processing to extend natural shelf life.
  • Complete batch traceability from raw material to final export packaging.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is the minimum order quantity for bahera powder manufacturer?

Our MOQ is flexible depending on your packaging and formulation needs. Typically, standard bulk orders start at 100 kg, but we accommodate custom trial runs for new partners.

What certifications and quality standards apply?

Our manufacturing aligns with strict food safety management systems, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), and comprehensive third-party lab testing for heavy metals and microbiology.

What are the packaging and shelf-life options?

We pack our powders in moisture-barrier food-grade bags, fiber drums, and stand-up pouches. When stored correctly, the product maintains its efficacy for up to 24 months.

What are the typical specifications (mesh, moisture, purity)?

Our standard powder features an 80-100 mesh size, less than 8% moisture content, and a guaranteed 99% purity level without artificial additives.

What is the lead time and how do I request a sample or quote?

Standard production and dispatch lead times range from 7 to 14 business days. Simply contact our sales team online to request a formal quotation or a product sample.
